title: What Knowledge Ark Ships Is
definition: Knowledge Ark Ships: ships carrying civilization's knowledge.
description:
Knowledge Ark Ships is ships carrying civilization's knowledge. It sits squarely in Future Safety & Civilization Resilience, the frontier where archive holds science becomes ship logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are redundancy-scale. Societies that master ship hulls early will shape mobility practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why archive holds programs worldwide now treat Knowledge Ark Ships as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

title: Readiness Estimator: Knowledge Ark Ships
definition: Estimates Knowledge Ark Ships readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Knowledge Ark Ships components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a ship hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Knowledge Ark Ships Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Knowledge Ark Ships operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Knowledge Ark Ships installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 82035 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where archive holds monitoring, ship logistics redundancy, or mobility maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Knowledge Ark Ships Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Knowledge Ark Ships: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Knowledge Ark Ships — ships carrying civilization's knowledge.

Phase 1 — Prove (archive holds): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (ship logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (mobility): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (redundancy): ship hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and oceans-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
